channel.title: Gorkhapatra | Nepal's First News Organization
channel.description: Gorkhapatra is the oldest national daily newspaper of Nepal. It is run by Gorkhapatra Sansthan. It was launched as a weekly in May 1901 and became a daily newspaper in 1961. Gorkhapatra Online is Nepal's oldest newspaper which is now available in digital form as well.Nepal's digital newspaper, online destination for Nepal news, views, reviews, features, blogs and audio video content covering Nepali politics, society, market, arts, entertainment, global, sports.
